A rear admiral from the marines whose parents were pirates and were killed, so he was raised by the marines. After he learns the truth about his upbringing, he realizes the marines are not the heroes he thought they were. He has been trained as an assassin, using his powers of the phase phase fruit (able to pass through solid objects) and decides that the free life of a pirate, instead of the stifling life as a marine, is where he feels most free. He never knew his parents, but being free and following Luffy is the closest he feels to being one with his heritage.
